headline: Greece second worldwide in table olive exports – Zoukas: Need for a coherent strategy to support the sector
summary: Greece ranks second globally in table olive exports, with more than 90% of domestic production reportedly exported. Industry representative Zoukas called for a coherent strategy to support the sector.
why: Table olives are a significant agricultural export, and exporter performance depends on global demand, pricing and government support policies.
